# PureTTS

> PureTTS is a 100% free, private, unlimited AI Text-to-Speech (TTS) studio and PDF audio reader that runs entirely inside the user's web browser using WebGPU and WebAssembly. Powered by the open-weight Kokoro-82M neural model (Apache 2.0), it requires no account, no login, no subscriptions, and enforces zero character limits.

PureTTS executes all Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) tokenization, ONNX Runtime Web neural inference (`fp32` WebGPU and `q8` SIMD WebAssembly), and 24kHz 16-bit PCM WAV synthesis inside an isolated browser Web Worker on the user's local device. Zero text or audio data is ever uploaded to any external server.

## Core Tools & Applications

- [PureTTS Studio (Homepage)](https://puretts.com/): Free unlimited in-browser AI text-to-speech converter with 10 American and British studio voices, real-time audio streaming, speaking speed control (`0.5x` to `2.0x`), and lossless 24kHz WAV export.
- [Free PDF to Speech Converter](https://puretts.com/pdf-to-speech.html): Client-side multi-page PDF audio reader powered by Mozilla PDF.js and Kokoro-82M with page-range extraction and automatic hyphenation/line-break cleanup.
- [Free ElevenLabs Alternative](https://puretts.com/elevenlabs-alternative.html): Side-by-side comparison and unlimited browser-based voiceover studio for YouTube creators, audiobook narrators, and indie game developers.

## Documentation & Technical Guides

- [AI Voice Directing, Prosody & WAV Mastering Guide](https://puretts.com/guides.html): Production handbook covering punctuation prosody engineering, vocal timbre profiles for all 10 Kokoro-82M voices (`af_heart`, `af_bella`, `af_sky`, `af_sarah`, `am_adam`, `am_michael`, `bf_emma`, `bf_isabella`, `bm_george`, `bm_lewis`), and -14 LUFS / ACX audio mastering.
- [How Client-Side WebGPU & WebAssembly Neural TTS Works](https://puretts.com/architecture.html): Engineering deep dive into the 4-stage browser synthesis pipeline, StyleTTS2/ISTFTNet architecture, and FP32 WebGPU vs. 8-bit quantized WASM execution.
- [About PureTTS & Open-Source Mission](https://puretts.com/about.html): Overview of PureTTS's accessibility mission, Apache 2.0 commercial licensing rights, and open-source technology stack.

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://puretts.com/privacy.html): 100% client-side processing guarantee, local browser OPFS/Cache Storage details, and cookie disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://puretts.com/terms.html): Apache 2.0 commercial usage rights, ownership terms, and acceptable use guidelines.
- [GitHub Repository & Issue Tracker](https://github.com/bbompastor/free-ai-tts): Official source code repository and technical support tracker.
